caption: The drawing depicts a folded fabric, likely a tea towel or handkerchief, laid out neatly with one corner folded over to reveal the pattern on both the front and back. The fabric is primarily off-white or light beige in color, featuring a pattern of blue and black lines forming a grid and plaid design. The majority of the towel displays a simple grid of thin blue lines intersecting to make squares, while the overlapping section, visible from the left and upper side of the towel, showcases a denser plaid pattern with both thicker and thinner lines in blue, black, and possibly dark green. There are slight signs of wear, such as faint stains and discolorations on the cloth. The texture and weave of the fabric are visible, and there is a faint monogram "CC" embroidered near the folded corner. The edges of the towel are slightly wrinkled, contributing to the realistic depiction. The artist's name, Chas Goodwin, is inscribed in the bottom right corner of the image. The background is a plain, light neutral color with no other objects present.
title: Shaker Kerchief
